items.title: AI Could Force 11 Million Americans to Change Careers. At 60, Five More Years Earning $70,000 Could Replace Five Zero Years in Social Security
items.summary: A 60-year-old loses his job to automation and faces a choice between retiring early and retraining. Hidden in his Social Security record are five blank years, and one common claiming mistake could erase everything a new paycheck might fix.

items.title: Hedge funds cut tech exposure at near-record pace as Nasdaq drops 6.4%
items.summary: Investing.com -- Hedge funds ran for the exits last week, and then the market bounced anyway. Tech was by far the most heavily net-sold sector, both globally and in the US, at a pace that roughly matched the record in Goldman Sachs prime brokerage data going back to 2016.

items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Stock Looks Cheap Based On Excess Returns

Goldman Sachs Group has risen 183.2% over the past 3 years, which puts real pressure on the numbers to show that the capital invested in the firm is being put to use at sufficiently strong returns.
